traditional: 望到 A 唔敢 V
jyutping: mong6 dou3 A m4 gam2 V

english.note: Use this result construction when fixedly looking at A causes A to be too intimidated to V.

examples.english: The teacher would stare at the child until he didn't dare move.
examples.traditional: 老師望到個細路唔敢郁。
examples.jyutping: lou5 si1 mong6 dou3 go3 sai3 lou6 m4 gam2 juk1
